findings.banquet_food_appeal: Retained: two long tables with place settings plus a high table on the dais in the Great Hall; food service route is drawn (kitchen yard -> kitchen -> screens -> hall).
findings.visual_identity: Warm stone, oak floors, slate roofs and red/gold banners/door markers are used across all three sheets.
findings.throne_triangles_and_filler: No throne ornament or rotated triangles appear; the dais is a plain high-table platform. No duplicate hearths: hall central hearth, two kitchen hearths, and stacked flues documented per wall. Brazier-like unclear props from shot 4 are not carried over.
findings.rooms_doors_stairs: Every room is labelled with a purpose; D1-D16 and U1-U5 doors are scheduled with what they connect; S1/S2/W1/W2 list both-floor destinations and are marked on plan. This answers shot-4 stair-legibility and shot-5 stair-arrival concerns at plan level.
findings.service_and_guard_circulation: Service route stays behind the screens and never crosses the feast court; guard route barracks -> muster yard -> W2 -> gatehouse/wall walk; postern route via herb garden.
findings.labels: Readable at sheet resolution. Minor: the 'S1 GROUND' tag partly overlaps the spiral symbol on the upper sheet; legible, not material.
findings.new_footprint: Completely new polygonal curtain, two wards, bent approach, twin-D gatehouse and L-range with round donjon, unlike the rectangular v1 in shots 2/4/5.

outcome: No material visual or geometry problem found. Geometry and renderer unchanged; no rerender or revalidation performed (prior 'python validate.py' ALL CHECKS PASSED stands).
limits: Still-image plan review only. Reference screenshots show the current v1 game, used to check feedback is answered, not as a v2 likeness. Castle references remain text-only (Bodiam National Trust page, Harlech Wikipedia); no plan images viewed. No camera, collision, navmesh or in-engine test. No mechanics, lore, king/story or extra rooms added.
